title: India is not READY for AI - Here's Why !
description:
There was a time when seeing something with your own eyes meant it was real. But today, with the rise of AI-generated videos, deepfakes, and hyper-realistic fake content, that simple assumption no longer holds true.

From viral videos like fake Maggi capsule transformations to subtle AI glitches like extra fingers or objects behaving unnaturally, we are entering a world where reality itself can be manufactured.

In this video, we explore how AI is reshaping what we see, why our brains are not prepared for it, how people are already being fooled by convincing fake videos, and most importantly, how you can identify what is real and what is not.

If you’ve searched for AI fake videos, deepfake examples, how to detect AI videos, or why you can’t trust what you see anymore, this video gives you the rational perspective. Don’t forget to subscribe, like, comment, and share…

00:00 – When Seeing Meant Truth
02:00 – The First Crack: Images vs Reality
04:10 – AI Videos That Look Real (Maggi & More)

09:45 – How to Spot What’s Fake
